messages:
Nora Blake: Quick ideaor the role grant flow: show an "exposure score" (0-100) for the selected role that sums route reachability + quota risk + confidence. Keep it simple inline.
Diego Marquez: Exposure score? how calculated?
Nora Blake: rough calc: weighted sum of endpoints_exposed (30%), traffic_pct_exposed (40%), quota_saturation_risk (30%). show components in a small breakdown modal.
Rina Patel: We can compute this with a dry-run indexer that precomputes role->route maps and joins with 14d traffic histograms. do NOT include payloads.
Kai Morris: API sketch (internal):
POST /internal/rbac/exposure_dryrun {tenant, role, lookback_days}
Response: exposure_score, endpoints_exposed, traffic_pct, quota_risk, confidence, index_ts
metrics-bot: indexer job scheduled: rbac-exposure-indexer v1 will run nightly and seed /internal/rbac/exposure cache :rocket:
Diego Marquez: UX notes: default collapse of breakdown, inline chip says "Exposure 42 (low)"; modal shows sparkline + why the confidence is low (low sample count).
Rina Patel: Privacy: must be opt-in per-tenant. Console should show admin toggle: "Enable exposure previews (aggregated metrics only)". Default off.
Kai Morris: Implementation caveat: roles with conditional scopes (ip-limited, ttl) should show a separate tag and not be included in the aggregate score unless tenant chooses to evaluate conditionals.
Nora Blake: Action: Nora -> small mock of chip + modal. Diego -> console copy and toggle. Rina -> indexer spec + cache TTL. Kai -> proto for /internal/rbac/exposure_dryrun. metrics-bot: will notify when first index completes.
Diego Marquez: SGTM. Keep numbers approximate and surface assumptions prominently. :thumbsup:
